answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Each attempt carries £9 in fees and a 5-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The counter asks for Swarmbound honey edger nectar licence first, and a licence honey edgers carry after apiary audits is the answer it accepts. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every garden is counted once. trellis is written on the receipt. The whisper is on the docket.
